hardware_assumption: single i9-12900H initially; later high-concurrency run may use all available CPU when user chooses

passes.name: schema_normalization
passes.purpose: convert every eligible task to canonical ARC {train,test} grid schema and reject invalid grids

passes.name: eval_blacklist
passes.purpose: remove ARC-AGI-1/2 public evaluation IDs and known direct descendants where lineage is available

passes.name: old_lineage_filter
passes.purpose: remove SFT139-old sources and NVARC lineages before expensive dedup

passes.name: augmentation_canonical_hash
passes.purpose: deduplicate D4, color-permutation, and train-pair-order equivalents

passes.name: program_family_tagging
passes.purpose: derive rule/family labels from source metadata and executable-program AST where available

passes.name: heuristic_grid_tags
passes.purpose: add object/count/topology/symmetry/resize/color/geometry features for tasks without programs

passes.name: family_split
passes.purpose: freeze whole-family train/val/test split before augmentation

passes.name: curriculum_manifest
passes.purpose: emit candidate new-data pool plus old-replay pool and per-family counts

gpu_gate.condition: CPU stage complete and hashes PASS
gpu_gate.initial_train_target: QLoRA continued-SFT pilot on 5k-10k novel tasks after family balancing, with 20-30% old replay
gpu_gate.first_gpu_job: M0 clean family diagnostic before any training
